name: Mqtt → Publish Json
description: Publish a JSON-formatted MQTT message on a topic using this action in automations.

config_entries.label: Topic
config_entries.description: The MQTT topic to publish the message.

config_entries.label: QOS
config_entries.description: The [Quality of Service](https://www.hivemq.com/blog/mqtt-essentials-part-6-mqtt-quality-of-service-levels) level of the topic. Defaults to 0.

config_entries.label: Retain
config_entries.description: If the published message should have a retain flag on or not. Defaults to `false`.
